sentences.text: Noripterus is a genus of dsungaripterid pterodactyloid pterosaur, a group of flying reptiles whose name translates to 'lake wing'.
Estimates suggest this creature was roughly one-third shorter than the similar Dsungaripterus that lived at the same time.
Its skeleton featured elongated neck vertebrae, a head crest, and a front lower jaw lacking teeth.
The remaining teeth in its mouth were robust and widely spaced apart.
Unlike the upward-curving snout of Dsungaripterus, Noripterus possessed a straight, sharp beak.
Yang Zhongjian first named the genus in 1973.
The type species, Noripterus complicidens, was discovered within the Lianmuqin and Shengjinkou Formations of the Junggar Basin in Xinjiang, China.
A second species, Noripterus parvus, was later recovered from the Tsagaantsav Formation of Mongolia.
Researchers propose that while Dsungaripterus hunted hard-shelled animals in shallow waters, Noripterus fed on fish in deeper lake regions.
The genus is assigned to the family Dsungaripteridae based on its resemblance to Dsungaripterus.
A 2019 study by Kellner and colleagues placed Noripterus outside Azhdarchoidea within Tapejaroidea as a sister taxon to Dsungaripterus.

The genus Phobetor, originally described by Natasha Bakhurina in 1982 from a single leg bone, was later deemed unavailable due to prior use with a fish, and in 2009 Lü and colleagues found it indistinguishable from Noripterus, referring it as a junior synonym.
Fossil evidence indicates Noripterus lived from the Valanginian to the Barremian, spanning between 137.05 and 121.4 million years ago.
Some data suggests at least certain deposits containing this animal date to the middle Valanginian, though exact age boundaries remain uncertain.
It inhabited environments characterized by extensive inland lake systems alongside the larger Dsungaripterus.
It is likely that Noripterus and Dsungaripterus occupied separate ecological niches due to differences in skull robustness and tooth strength.
